display.purpose: Main promise. The primitive is the observed 88px desktop upper bound; source CSS uses clamp(54px, 6.3vw, 88px), 64px at max-width 1050px, and clamp(49px, 11.8vw, 78px) at max-width 760px.

wordmark.purpose: Home link, 44px desktop and 36px at max-width 760px.

headline.purpose: Work-state heading, 30px desktop and 28px at max-width 760px.

title.purpose: 24px result heading; line height is not explicitly set in source.

body.purpose: 18px introductory copy, reduced to 16px at max-width 760px.

upload-title.purpose: Filename or empty-upload instruction; wraps arbitrary filenames.

label.purpose: File chooser and tilted photo caption.

status.purpose: Polite live status with textual errors; error weight is 600.

metadata.purpose: Clip limits, formats, counts, durations, privacy, and result notes. Durations/counts use tabular numerals.

components.name: Conversion Button

narrative.overview:
Miau is loud, friendly, and deliberately unserious. Blunt, tightly set display lettering and broad electric color fields give a small audio tool the immediacy of a lyric sheet. A real cat photograph supplies the personality; the interface stays practical, with clear file selection, understated supporting text, and native playback controls.

The world is flat and spacious outside the workbench, compact and orderly inside it. Personality comes from scale, color contrast, a lightly tilted photo caption, and the actual sound comparison rather than extra interface chrome. The same workbench carries input, progress, and output, so a playful promise resolves into something visitors can hear and keep.
keyCharacteristics: Electric cobalt ground and an acid-yellow working surface.
Self-hosted, heavy Bricolage Grotesque display lettering with neutral system text.
Rounded rectangles, thin rules, and flat surfaces without shadows.
Real cat photography and signal-derived rectangular waveform bars.
Direct, visible controls with restrained color-only transitions.

rules.name: The Two Fields Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt as the surrounding ground and acid yellow as the working surface; reserve their supporting tones for control states, guidance, and separators.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep expressive Bricolage lettering for the wordmark and headings; use neutral system text for instructions, controls, and measurements.

rules.name: The Flat Signal Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with broad color fields and thin rules; keep signal bars and controls flat rather than adding dimensional decoration.

dos: **Do** preserve the cobalt ground, acid-yellow working field, and legible ink/white text assignments.
**Do** pair Bricolage headings with neutral system instructions and native controls.
**Do** retain the actual responsive reflow, full-width actions, and wrapping workbench heading.
**Do** keep visible keyboard focus, textual status/error feedback, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** use actual audio samples for waveform geometry and clearly label the synthetic demo input.
donts: **Don't** add shadows or dimensional control effects to the flat fields and thin-rule vocabulary.
**Don't** turn the tilted photo caption into a repeated decorative badge or eyebrow pattern.
**Don't** replace real signal bars with invented waveform decoration.
**Don't** use disabled olive tones for enabled actions or omit the textual explanation of an error.
**Don't** assume the browser-owned audio controls have identical appearance across engines.
